description_en: Creates a WebIDE workspace for a plugin
kebab_example: aliyun apig create-plugin-workspace --organization-id 664f1e2xxxx --repo-name my-custom-plugin --workspace-name my-plugin --gateway-type AI --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePluginWorkspace

parameters.help_en: The gateway type. If this parameter is not specified, the server uses API as the default value
parameters.help_zh: 网关类型,缺省时服务端默认 API
parameters.name: gateway_type

parameters.help_en: The Codeup organization ID. This is the Yunxiao DevOps organization ID, which can be obtained by parsing the response of the ListPluginRepositories operation or by creating an organization
parameters.help_zh: Codeup 组织 ID（云效 DevOps 组织，前端从 ListPluginRepositories 解析或自建组织后取得）
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The repository name, which also serves as the English ID of the plugin. The backend does not validate the format. The frontend restricts the value to the pattern /^(?![-.])[a-z0-9.-]{1,20}(?<![-.])$/, which means 1 to 20 lowercase letters, digits, periods, or hyphens that cannot start or end with a period or hyphen
parameters.help_zh: 仓库名（同时作为插件英文 ID）。后端不校验格式；前端限制 /^(?![-.])[a-z0-9.-]{1,20}(?<![-.])$/，即 1-20 位小写字母/数字/点/连字符，不能以 . 或 - 开头结尾
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en: The workspace name, which is the Chinese name of the plugin. This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns a 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty error
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称（插件中文名）。注意：本参数实际为必填项；省略时，API 返回 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty
parameters.name: workspace_name

repoId.description_en: The Codeup repository ID, which is a numeric string
repoId.description_zh: Codeup 仓库 ID（数字字符串）
